Framework_Name: Trichromatic Color Vision (Young–Helmholtz / Additive & Subtractive Primaries)
Core_Triad: Long-wavelength cone / Red (L-cone, ~564nm peak) — in additive model: Red. In subtractive (printing): Cyan. The structural anchor of trichromatic space; provides the warm/cool axis foundation. | Medium-wavelength cone / Green (M-cone, ~534nm peak) — in additive: Green. In subtractive: Magenta. The luminance-dominant channel; carries the highest spatial resolution in human vision. | Short-wavelength cone / Blue (S-cone, ~420nm peak) — in additive: Blue. In subtractive: Yellow. The least numerous cone type (~5–10% of cones); provides the blue-yellow axis closure of the color space.

The color solid (CIE chromaticity diagram) is a 3D manifold generated by the three cone fundamentals. This is a biological proof of irreducible triadicity in perception.

Framework_Name: Separation of Powers / Three Branches of Government (Trias Politica)
Core_Triad: Legislative Power (puissance législative) — the structural ground: creates law, defines the normative field, establishes the rules within which the other two powers operate. Parliament/Congress. | Executive Power (puissance exécutrice) — the drive: enforces law, acts in the world, wages war, conducts diplomacy. The active principle that translates legislation into reality. President/Prime Minister. | Judicial Power (puissance de juger) — registration and closure: interprets law, adjudicates disputes, determines whether executive action and legislative enactment conform to constitutional constraints. The courts.
UTCP_Mapping: I≈Legislative Power (puissance législative) — the structural ground: creates law, defines the normative field, establishes the rules within which the other two powers operate. The constitutional order is the emergent product of their mutual constraint. Montesquieu: "power must check power."

Registration/closure: the insight that completes the diagnostic — the "self" that suffers is itself a construction.
